# Highland Hills Baptist Church

> Highland Hills Baptist Church (HHBC) is an independent, fundamental Baptist church in Highland, Michigan. We preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ from the King James Bible and welcome families from across the Highland area. Visitors are always welcome.

## Key Facts

- Name: Highland Hills Baptist Church (HHBC)
- Type: Independent Baptist church (King James Version / KJV)
- Address: 179 Woodruff Lake Rd, Highland, MI 48357
- Phone: (248) 887-0698
- Email: highlandhillsbaptistchurch1611@gmail.com
- Senior Pastor: Matt Leathley (since January 2024)
- Serving: Highland, Milford, White Lake, Commerce Township, Hartland, Waterford, Wixom, Holly, and Clarkston, Michigan (Oakland & Livingston County)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HHBC1611/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@highlandhillsbaptistchurch4533

## Service Times

- Sunday School — 10:00 AM (Sunday)
- Morning Worship — 11:00 AM (Sunday)
- Evening Worship — 6:00 PM (Sunday)
- Prayer & Bible Study — 7:00 PM (Wednesday)
- Children's Program — 7:00 PM (Wednesday)
- Nursery is available for all services.

## Beliefs (Summary)

Highland Hills Baptist Church believes in the verbally inspired, inerrant Word of God (using the King James Version); one God eternally existing as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit; the deity, virgin birth, atoning death, and bodily resurrection of Jesus Christ; salvation by grace through faith in Christ alone (not by works); the eternal security of the believer; the local church and the ordinances of believer's baptism by immersion and the Lord's Supper; and the personal return of Jesus Christ.

## Contact & Visiting

Anyone is welcome to attend. Come as you are — there is no dress code, and guests are never pressured to give. To plan a visit or ask a question, call (248) 887-0698 or message the church on Facebook.
